2. The suit was filed seeking declaration of title in respect of 6.29 acres of land contending, inter alia, that the said land belonged to Tarangini Devi and she verbally settled the same at a rental of Tk.12/- to the plaintiff in Chaitra, 1350 B.S., that prior to the settlement the property in suit was a Khal, but with the passage of time the same silted up and became cultivable, that R.S. record was prepared in the name of Tarangini Devi but subsequently the land was recorded in the name of the Government in khas khatian No.1, that neither the Government nor the heirs of Tarangini Devi had possession in the land in suit, that in the month of Baishakh, 1401 B.S. local Thasilder challenged the title of the plaintiff and hence the suit seeking relief as stated hereinbefore. 

 3. The suit was contested by the Government by filing written statement denying the material averments made in the plaint and stating, inter alia, that land measuring 17.63 acres has been listed in S.A. Khatian No.1 and land measuring 4 acres appertaining to plot No. 164 and the land measuring 29 decimals out of 2.98 acres was the khas land and the same was a Khal and at the present the land in suit possessed by public in general. The plaintiff has no title and possession in the land in suit and as such the suit is liable to be dismissed.
